pending_seams: Target-B differential parity awaits the enlarged cluster-mesh 0.9.0 contract and capability bundle.
The native signed wake identity contains from, to, instruction, nonce, and time only; it is not durably bound to target registration, holder, or epoch and exposes no durable receipt.
After an F1 pre-effect failure, worker restart seeds the still-pending envelope as boot backlog and suppresses the required retry.
Concurrent F2 and F3 attempts re-sign the same envelope with different nonces and can produce two terminal wakes; the phase oracle rejects the unreconciled lost-receipt result.
The native handler has no registration-revocation input; revoking its signer key does not prevent a physical wake, while stale presence fails closed because no launch context resolves.
Contract-grade BUFFER_OVERFLOW, PIPE_CLOSED, and NO_CONTROLLING_TERMINAL outcomes and a direct read-only mode are absent from the native boolean result.
